scope: Independent saved-pixel display review of the eight supplied whole Exercise 7 desktop/mobile text, written, answers, and choices screenshots only.
statusBasis: No actionable clipping, overlap, broken wrapping, misplaced figure, or gross readability defect was visible in these eight single-open whole-image views. PASS is bounded to the supplied static evidence at the viewer-displayed resolution, not unrestricted full-resolution or interaction approval.

observations: The Exercise 7 heading, single-line chapter/page metadata, and blue exercise-navigation button occupy distinct rows inside the centered content column.
The heading and metadata are legible; the button label and arrow are contained within its blue background. No right-edge clipping or vertical collision is visible.
The remaining image is blank white space; this screenshot contains no body paragraphs or figure to inspect.
limits: Only the captured 1440x960 static state is assessed. Blank space is not evidence about whether other content should exist.
